summary.en: A routine day in Namibia: no major crisis is apparent. Rising tourism occupancy, dialogue with Angola, the upcoming ILO regional meeting in Windhoek, and energy cooperation are positive. A slowdown in mining (diamond stagnation, inflation and high interest rates), corruption and judicial controversies, and allegations of harsh intervention by an anti-poaching unit offset this positive effect.

en: Tourism occupancy rising to 66.5%
Bilateral talks with Angola and the ILO Africa regional meeting
Pressure on the mining sector from the diamond decline, inflation and high interest rates
Trust in the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) and calls for the Finestar investigation
Allegations of harsh intervention by the anti-poaching unit and debate over violence

summary.en: The period is mostly routine but leans positive, with Namibia and Angola signing seven agreements and pledging deeper economic cooperation, plus progress on a manganese refinery and approval of a lithium project sale. Offsetting concerns include a reported diamond output slump, rising fuel costs, reliance on electricity imports and fears of illegal sand mining.

en: Namibia-Angola signed seven agreements at first bilateral commission
Manganese refinery plans advance in Walvis Bay
Karibib lithium project sale receives greenlight

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with mildly positive economic and diplomatic news: growth projected to outpace South Africa, US investor outreach, a Namibia-Angola cooperation pledge, and new export access for grapes to China. Negatives were limited to a heatwave warning and ongoing Fishrot and anti-corruption proceedings, with no crisis reported.

en: Economy projected to grow faster than South Africa's
US ambassador pitching Namibia to American investors
Namibia-Angola pledge deeper bilateral cooperation

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: a cut in the 2026 growth forecast to 2.3% and a drought threatening around 400,000 people weigh against a surge in uranium exports and new sustainable-finance lending. A contested petroleum bill and a minor 4.9 earthquake add tension without signalling a crisis.

en: Growth forecast cut to 2.3% as mining revenue drops
Uranium exports surge while diamond production falls
Drought threatens nearly 400,000 people

summary.en: The period is largely routine, with a clear positive economic development: the N$5.8bn Etango uranium mine received its final investment decision and moves to full-scale construction, with officials citing jobs and output gains. Other headlines are ordinary business, social and sports news, and the GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: Etango uranium mine final investment decision and construction start
Minister says Etango will boost output and create jobs
Bannerman commits $353M to uranium mine, backing investment outlook

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: debate over mining contracts, youth council appointments, and diplomatic and energy talks. The main negative is wildfires affecting about 16% of Etosha National Park during extreme heat, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Wildfires affecting 16% of Etosha National Park amid extreme heat
Routine debate over short-term contracts in mining operations
Energy and technology cooperation talks with Russia

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic news, notably approval of a US$353M uranium mine and a final permit for a Kayelekera shipment, with setbacks including a rate hike, livestock disease losses, Etosha fires and a salary-records dispute. Most headlines are routine, so the score sits near the ordinary baseline, slightly lowered by the negative tone.

en: Bannerman uranium mine approval and Kayelekera shipment permit
Standard Bank rate hike and FNB bond deadline
FMD could cost livestock industry N$2.4bn

summary.en: A mixed, mostly routine news day: agricultural stress from a foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak and a South African feedlot ban, plus a cash crunch delaying pay, sit alongside positive developments like the Norasa environmental renewal, a proposed climate-action law and completed road projects. The GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, which pulls the score slightly below neutral.

en: FMD restrictions and South African feedlot ban hitting farmers
Cash crunch delaying pay in Rundu
Norasa environmental clearance renewal and wind-farm hopes

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: sports wins, a state funeral, a presidential visit to Moscow and community income projects. Negatives are modest, including a health recruitment freeze, foot-and-mouth restrictions hurting vendors and farmers, and 900 pupils dropping out, so the score sits slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Namibia's sports wins and national championship results
Health Ministry halts recruitment of new staff
Foot-and-mouth restrictions hitting marketing and vendors

summary.en: Namibia's news over the period is mostly routine, with a mix of positive investment and infrastructure items (a N$1.6bn wind farm, a $140m Green Climate Fund approval, expanded vocational training). Offsetting concerns include a foot-and-mouth outbreak with 131 cases, a central bank rate hike to 7%, and a missed land resettlement target.

en: N$1.6bn Lüderitz wind farm supports energy supply
Green Climate Fund approves $140m for decarbonisation
Foot-and-mouth cases reach 131 with movement restrictions

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: diplomatic engagement with Russia, a bank-backed water project and economic and cybersecurity commentary, alongside ordinary crime and a hospital over capacity. Precautionary Ebola preparedness and a fatal grazing-land dispute are minor negatives, so the score sits slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Putin meets Namibian president; trade and joint ventures discussed
NBL backs Swakop water project
Ebola preparedness ramped up at entry points

summary.en: The period is largely routine: infrastructure expansion (Paratus fibre), preparations for the Dakar Youth Olympics, and diplomatic contact with Russia sit alongside health-sector disputes, delayed municipal salaries and a foot-and-mouth disease containment effort. Mild negative tone from GDELT is offset by these constructive stories, so the day is close to an ordinary baseline.

en: Paratus adds 600km to fibre network
Nurses and doctors protest recruitment freeze and tariffs
Rundu Town Council October salaries delayed

summary.en: The period is largely routine, with several positive economic signals: the Etango uranium mine was approved for full-scale construction, a new egg export market opened in Botswana, and the stock market rose. Offsetting these are foot-and-mouth disease containment pressures, underfunding concerns, and a fatal land dispute.

en: Etango uranium mine approved for full-scale construction
Market report shows stock market gains led by MTC
Egg export market access expanded to Botswana

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with a historic maiden ODI series win over Ireland and approval of the Leonardville uranium project as the main positives. Negatives include a seven-fatality road crash, violent and sexual crime reports, and rate hikes raising mortgage costs; GDELT tone (-0.09) is less negative than the world average.

en: Historic maiden ODI series win over Ireland
Leonardville uranium project approved
Rate hikes add N$4,000 a year to mortgages

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: cultural, sports and community news, plus development approvals such as a uranium project and green funding. A road accident that killed a musician and seven others and a looming fisheries strike are the main negatives, and the tone signal is mildly positive.

en: Leonardville uranium project approved
Green funding spotlight on Erongo industrial projects
Road accident killed musician and seven others

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: business investment, sports sponsorship, international cooperation deals and a positive GDELT tone (+1.72 against a world average of -0.50). Negative items such as crime reports, child abuse cases and aquifer concerns are ordinary and do not amount to a crisis.

en: Namibia and China sign Olympic cooperation agreement
Eagles win Ireland series, FNB sponsors Women's Super League
Breweries and Andrada announce water project and economic contributions

summary.en: The period is dominated by a major positive economic development: a $2.5 billion Dangote fuel storage and pipeline investment, widely covered in foreign and domestic media. Offsetting this are foot-and-mouth losses, a Grade 11 exam leak, utility cuts and budget criticism, which keep the score below the top of the positive range.

en: $2.5bn Dangote fuel hub launch, widely reported as a major investment
Namibia–South Korea Olympic MoU and first state-owned air ambulances
FMD restrictions projected to cost N$2.4bn in value-chain losses

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with positive signals from the foot-and-mouth outbreak being contained, a large Dangote fuel storage and pipeline investment, and a first dividend from NAC. These are offset by rising inflation to 5.6% and a N$11 diesel price surge that threatens mining jobs and tax revenue.

en: FMD outbreak contained with no new cases recorded
Dangote announces $2.5bn tank farm and pipeline investment
Inflation climbs to 5.6% in October

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: culture, sport and business coverage, with several investment announcements, including a US$2.5 billion fuel pipeline, a Coca-Cola water project and a new airline. Negatives are limited to rising fuel costs, a contained foot-and-mouth outbreak and union frustration over labour reform delays.
summary.ja: この期間は主に日常的な報道で、文化、スポーツ、ビジネスの記事が中心です。25億米ドル規模の燃料パイプライン、コカ・コーラの水関連事業、新しい航空会社など、いくつかの投資発表がありました。マイナス要素は、燃料費の上昇、口蹄疫の発生（封じ込め済み）、そして労働制度改革の遅れに対する労働組合の不満に限られています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 보도로, 문화, 스포츠, 비즈니스 기사가 중심입니다. 25억 달러 규모의 연료 파이프라인, 코카콜라의 수자원 사업, 신규 항공사 설립 등 여러 투자 발표가 있었습니다. 부정적인 요소는 연료비 상승, 억제된 구제역 발생, 노동 개혁 지연에 대한 노조의 불만에 국한됩니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित समाचारों की है, जिसमें संस्कृति, खेल और व्यापार से जुड़ी खबरें शामिल हैं। कई निवेश घोषणाएँ हुई हैं, जिनमें 2.5 अरब अमेरिकी डॉलर की ईंधन पाइपलाइन, कोका-कोला की जल परियोजना और एक नई एयरलाइन शामिल हैं। नकारात्मक पहलू केवल बढ़ती ईंधन लागत, नियंत्रित खुरपका-मुंहपका रोग के प्रकोप और श्रम सुधार में देरी से यूनियनों की निराशा तक सीमित हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική, με ειδήσεις για τον πολιτισμό, τον αθλητισμό και την επιχειρηματικότητα. Έγιναν αρκετές ανακοινώσεις επενδύσεων, μεταξύ των οποίων ένας αγωγός καυσίμων αξίας 2,5 δισεκατομμυρίων δολαρίων ΗΠΑ, ένα έργο ύδρευσης της Coca-Cola και μια νέα αεροπορική εταιρεία. Οι αρνητικές εξελίξεις περιορίζονται στην άνοδο του κόστους καυσίμων, σε ένα περιορισμένο κρούσμα αφθώδους πυρετού και στη δυσαρέσκεια των συνδικάτων για την καθυστέρηση της μεταρρύθμισης της εργασίας.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin: kültür, spor ve iş haberleriyle geçiyor; 2,5 milyar ABD doları tutarındaki bir yakıt boru hattı, bir Coca-Cola su projesi ve yeni bir havayolu şirketi dahil birkaç yatırım duyurusu yapıldı. Olumsuz gelişmeler yalnızca artan yakıt maliyetleri, kontrol altına alınmış bir şap salgını ve iş gücü reformundaki gecikmelerden duyulan sendika hoşnutsuzluğuyla sınırlı.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: cobertura de cultura, deportes y negocios, con varios anuncios de inversión, entre ellos un oleoducto de combustible de 2.500 millones de dólares estadounidenses, un proyecto de agua de Coca-Cola y una nueva aerolínea. Los aspectos negativos se limitan al aumento de los costos del combustible, a un brote de fiebre aftosa contenido y a la frustración sindical por los retrasos en la reforma laboral.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : actualités culturelles, sportives et économiques, avec plusieurs annonces d'investissements, dont un pipeline de carburant de 2,5 milliards de dollars américains, un projet d'eau de Coca-Cola et une nouvelle compagnie aérienne. Les aspects négatifs se limitent à la hausse des coûts du carburant, à un foyer de fièvre aphteuse contenu et à la frustration des syndicats face aux retards de la réforme du travail.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Berichterstattung über Kultur, Sport und Wirtschaft, mit mehreren Investitionsankündigungen, darunter eine Treibstoffpipeline im Wert von 2,5 Milliarden US-Dollar, ein Wasserprojekt von Coca-Cola und eine neue Fluggesellschaft. Negative Entwicklungen beschränken sich auf steigende Treibstoffkosten, einen eingedämmten Ausbruch der Maul- und Klauenseuche sowie Frustration der Gewerkschaften über Verzögerungen bei der Arbeitsmarktreform.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro: cobertura de cultura, esporte e negócios, com vários anúncios de investimento, incluindo um oleoduto de combustível de US$ 2,5 bilhões, um projeto de água da Coca-Cola e uma nova companhia aérea. Os aspectos negativos se limitam ao aumento dos custos do combustível, a um surto de febre aftosa contido e à frustração sindical com os atrasos na reforma trabalhista.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: copertura di cultura, sport e business, con diversi annunci di investimento, tra cui un gasdotto per carburanti da 2,5 miliardi di dollari USA, un progetto idrico di Coca-Cola e una nuova compagnia aerea. Gli aspetti negativi si limitano all'aumento dei costi del carburante, a un focolaio contenuto di afta epizootica e alla frustrazione dei sindacati per i ritardi nella riforma del lavoro.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: освещение культуры, спорта и бизнеса, несколько объявлений об инвестициях, включая топливный трубопровод стоимостью 2,5 млрд долларов США, водный проект Coca-Cola и новую авиакомпанию. Негативные факторы ограничиваются ростом цен на топливо, локализованной вспышкой ящура и недовольством профсоюзов задержками трудовой реформы.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: تغطية للثقافة والرياضة والأعمال، مع عدة إعلانات استثمارية، منها خط أنابيب وقود بقيمة 2.5 مليار دولار أمريكي، ومشروع مياه لشركة كوكا كولا، وشركة طيران جديدة. وتقتصر السلبيات على ارتفاع تكاليف الوقود، وتفشٍ محدود لمرض الحمى القلاعية، وإحباط النقابات من تأخر إصلاح قانون العمل.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال‌معمول است: پوشش فرهنگی، ورزشی و تجاری، با چند اعلام سرمایه‌گذاری از جمله یک خط لوله سوخت به ارزش 2.5 میلیارد دلار آمریکا، یک پروژه آبی کوکاکولا و یک شرکت هواپیمایی جدید. موارد منفی محدود است به افزایش هزینه سوخت، شیوع مهارشده تب برفکی و نارضایتی اتحادیه‌ها از تأخیر در اصلاحات قانون کار.
summary.zh: 本时段总体属于常规报道：涵盖文化、体育和商业新闻，并公布了多项投资消息，包括一条25亿美元的燃料管道、一项可口可乐水务项目以及一家新航空公司。负面因素仅限于燃料成本上升、一起已得到控制的口蹄疫疫情，以及工会对劳动制度改革进展迟缓的不满。

summary.en: Protests continue in Portugal over the housing crisis and rent reform. A tent camp in Lisbon and Porto was cleared by police, more than 50 people were detained, and a strike was called across the Iberian Peninsula. In contrast, economic and tourism news is positive, the stock market is moving sideways, and no severe crisis is apparent. The score is therefore slightly below the usual level.

en: Police clearance of housing protest tents in Lisbon and Porto, more than 50 detentions
Social backlash against rent and eviction reform, strike call across the Iberian Peninsula
Tourism awards and Lisbon being named one of Europe's best destinations
Limited stock market movement (daily +0.13%, monthly -1.43%)
GDELT tone markedly negative compared with the world average

summary.en: Housing and cost-of-living protests spread across Portugal, with police clearing tent camps in Lisbon, 55 arrests, and disputed claims of excessive force. Most other coverage is routine, and the PSI is roughly flat on the day, so the score sits just above the serious-problems band.

en: Police cleared Rossio and other protest camps; 55 arrested
Thousands protest housing crisis; foreign media coverage widespread
Disputed claims of excessive police force at Lisbon camp

summary.en: Housing protests in Lisbon and Porto drew thousands, with police clearing encampments, clashes and 55 reported detentions, and foreign coverage frames it as part of a wider European wave. Offsetting positives include a rise in the WJP Rule of Law Index, lynx population growth, and routine economic and institutional news, while the PSI fell modestly.

en: Police clearing housing protest camps in Lisbon, with clashes and 55 detentions
Protests spreading and vowing to continue, with a wider European protest wave
Portugal rising in WJP Rule of Law Index to 27th place

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news, with housing-crisis protests in Lisbon (around 200 people camping overnight, some arrests) and talk of a possible Iberian general strike on 11 November. The PSI rose 0.77% on the day, though it is down over the week and month, and M&A fell 37%, so the overall picture is mildly negative.

en: Lisbon housing protests with overnight camping and some arrests
Unions discussing a possible Iberian general strike on 11 November
M&A activity down 37% in the first half

summary.en: Portugal's last 24 hours mix routine news (scheduled power cuts, clock change, tourism concerns) with recurring, largely peaceful housing protests and a student climate strike in Lisbon. Markets were flat and press tone was slightly above average, so the day is close to an ordinary period with mild social strain.

en: Housing protests returning to Lisbon and Porto with tent camps
Ongoing housing crisis expected to take a decade to resolve
Student climate strike blocking Lisbon schools

summary.en: Large housing-cost protests spread across Lisbon, Porto and other cities over the period, with police clearing a protest camp in Lisbon, using batons and tasers, and making arrests, and seven protesters reported injured. A Gen Z general strike is being organised, and the stock index is modestly down over the week and month.

en: Police clear Lisbon housing protest camp, arrests and injuries reported
Mass housing protests in multiple Portuguese cities against high prices
Planned Gen Z general strike amid rising social discontent

summary.en: Police cleared housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto, with reports of 25 to 31 arrests and 27 injured, and protests have resumed with calls for a general strike. This is a serious domestic tension with a harsh crackdown, though the market dip is modest and most other news is routine.

en: Police clear housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto, mass arrests
Reported 27 injured and 31 detained; criticism of disproportionate force
Protests resume and general strike called over housing crisis

summary.en: Housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto were dismantled by police with batons and dogs, leaving 27 injured and 31 detained, and the protests are drawing pressure on the government and president. The rest of the day is routine: the 2027 budget debate starts and TAP resumes Caracas flights, but the stock index is down over the month.

en: Police dismantle housing protest camps; 27 injured, 31 detained
Government and president pressed to respond to housing protests
2027 budget debate begins in parliament

summary.en: Thousands protested outside Parliament over the housing crisis after police cleared encampments in Lisbon and Porto, with reports of 11 injured and detained protesters. Markets were roughly flat to slightly down, and the GDELT tone is milder than the world average, so the overall picture is serious social tension rather than a broader crisis.

en: Police clearing of housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto
Thousands rally outside Parliament over housing crisis
11 injured in encampment incident; protesters detained

summary.en: Portugal's last 24 hours mix routine and mildly positive news (a new Coloplast factory, a Lisbon housing land agreement, a slight stock gain, a notably positive news tone) with active tensions: thousands protested over housing outside parliament and police and GNR officers protested over pay. No crackdown or crisis is reported, so the period sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Coloplast opens new factory in Portugal, a foreign investment signal
Lisbon secures land reserve for housing in agreement with SGAL
Thousands protest housing outside Parliament; no harsh crackdown reported

summary.en: Portugal's news over the period is largely routine, with business and institutional items such as a Bank of Portugal office deal saving €35 million and a new Coloplast factory. Housing protests in Lisbon and a planned cost-of-living march add some social tension, but there is no clear crisis, and the stock index is roughly flat over the week.

en: Housing protests in Lisbon with police preparing for further demonstrations
Bank of Portugal new headquarters deal saving €35 million
Coloplast opens new factory in Portugal

summary.en: An ordinary day in Portugal with routine politics (Chega leadership vote), a government update that oil reserves were released as committed in March, and a cost-of-living and housing protest reported by a leftist outlet. Positive items include the Dakar 2027 start in Portugal and GDELT tone above the world average, offset by a 4% monthly stock decline and a fatal road accident in Spain involving a Portuguese citizen.

en: Government says oil reserve release under March commitment completed
Youth and workers mobilise over cost of living and housing
Dakar 2027 to start in Algarve, Portugal

summary.en: Thousands joined housing protests across Lisbon and other cities, and police cleared the Lisbon protest camps, with at least 10 detained and six injured. Foreign coverage is heavily negative, the PSI fell 4% over the month, and strikes are planned for November, pointing to serious social tension.

en: Police evacuated housing protest camps in Lisbon, with arrests and injuries
Thousands rallied nationwide against rents and housing costs
Further strikes and protests scheduled for November

summary.en: Police cleared housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto with clashes, 13 arrests and reports of many injuries, followed by a journalists' union complaint and calls for a Council of State meeting. Positive economic news (a KC-390 aircraft sale to Greece, Venezuela trade talk) and a stable stock market offset this, but the crackdown dominates.

en: Police clashes and camp clearances at housing protests in Lisbon and Porto
13 arrests and reports of over 100 injured in protest violence
Journalists' union complaint against PSP and Council of State meeting called

summary.en: A housing protest in Lisbon and Porto saw riot police clear camps at dawn, with 13 arrests and dozens hurt, and foreign outlets flagged it as a political pressure point. Otherwise the day was routine, with flat markets, a Constitutional Court review of protest rules, and ordinary business and diplomacy news.

en: Riot police cleared housing protest camps; 13 arrested, dozens hurt
Protest-law review reaches Constitutional Court; demonstrations continue
Routine economic and diplomatic news; stock index essentially flat

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with a signed TAP privatisation deal with Lufthansa and a 2.55% rise in the PSI index pointing to clearly positive economic signals. Housing protests, with police clearing camps and rights complaints to the UN, plus high fuel prices, temper the score.

en: TAP sale contract signed with Lufthansa, minority stake
PSI index up 2.55% in one day
Police clearing housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto

summary.en: Portugal's day mixed routine economic and political news with social strain: housing protests with police removals, a reported elderly death after a 12-hour emergency wait, and energy costs eroding purchasing power for about 70% of people. The PSI20 gained 1.22% and the fintech sector reported growth, which offsets some of the negatives.

en: Housing protests in Lisbon and Porto, with repeated police removals
Energy cost rise cutting purchasing power for ~70% of Portuguese
Elderly patient death after 12-hour emergency wait; IGAS inquiry opened

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: sports coverage dominated by Ronaldo's international retirement, a housing debate, and rain warnings from IPMA. The main negative is the detention of 86 protesters at the Lisbon encampment, while the PSI fell 1.27% on the day but rose over the week.

en: 86 protesters detained at Lisbon housing encampment, now before prosecutors
Housing policy debate and encampment refusing to leave Rossio
Ronaldo retirement dominates coverage, with no direct national impact

summary.en: The period looks routine for Portugal: most coverage is sports (Ronaldo's international retirement), with a weather alert from storm Bruna, a bomb threat on a Rome-Lisbon flight and ordinary housing and budget debates. Positive signals include 18% growth in canned-fish exports and a slightly firmer PSI over the week, so the score sits near the ordinary baseline.
summary.it: Il periodo appare ordinario per il Portogallo: la maggior parte della copertura riguarda lo sport (il ritiro di Ronaldo dalla nazionale), con un allerta meteo per la tempesta Bruna, una minaccia di bomba su un volo Roma-Lisbona e ordinari dibattiti su abitazioni e bilancio. I segnali positivi includono una crescita del 18% nelle esportazioni di pesce in scatola e un PSI leggermente più solido nel corso della settimana, quindi il punteggio si colloca vicino alla linea di base ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период выглядит для Португалии рутинным: большая часть освещения посвящена спорту (уход Роналду из сборной), есть предупреждение о погоде из-за шторма Бруна, угроза взрыва на рейсе Рим–Лиссабон и обычные дебаты о жилье и бюджете. Позитивные сигналы включают рост экспорта рыбных консервов на 18% и немного более уверенный индекс PSI за неделю, поэтому оценка находится около обычного базового уровня.
summary.ar: يبدو الوضع روتينيًا بالنسبة إلى البرتغال، إذ تدور معظم التغطية حول الرياضة (اعتزال رونالدو اللعب الدولي)، مع تحذير من الطقس بسبب العاصفة برونا، وتهديد بوجود قنبلة على رحلة روما-لشبونة، ونقاشات معتادة حول الإسكان والميزانية. وتشمل الإشارات الإيجابية نموًا بنسبة 18% في صادرات الأسماك المعلبة وارتفاعًا طفيفًا في مؤشر PSI خلال الأسبوع، لذا تقع النتيجة قرب خط الأساس المعتاد.
summary.fa: دوره برای پرتغال عادی به نظر می‌رسد: بیشتر پوشش خبری به ورزش (بازنشستگی بین‌المللی رونالدو) اختصاص دارد، با هشدار هواشناسی درباره طوفان برونا، تهدید بمب در پرواز رم–لیسبون و بحث‌های معمول درباره مسکن و بودجه. نشانه‌های مثبت شامل رشد ۱۸ درصدی صادرات ماهی کنسروی و شاخص PSI که در طول هفته کمی قوی‌تر شده، بنابراین امتیاز نزدیک به خط مبنای معمول است.
summary.zh: 葡萄牙的这一时期看起来较为平常：大部分报道与体育相关（C罗宣布退出国家队），此外还有风暴布鲁纳的天气预警、罗马至里斯本航班的炸弹威胁，以及日常的住房和预算讨论。积极信号包括罐装鱼出口增长18%，以及PSI指数在本周略有走强，因此评分接近常规基线。
summary.tr: Dönem Portekiz için olağan görünüyor: haberlerin çoğu spor haberleri (Ronaldo'nun milli takım kariyerini bırakması), Bruna fırtınası nedeniyle bir hava uyarısı, Roma-Lizbon uçuşunda bir bomba ihbarı ve sıradan konut ve bütçe tartışmaları. Olumlu sinyaller arasında konserve balık ihracatında %18 artış ve hafta boyunca biraz yükselen PSI yer alıyor; bu nedenle skor olağan temel düzeye yakın.
summary.es: El periodo parece rutinario para Portugal: la mayor parte de la cobertura es deportiva (la retirada internacional de Ronaldo), con una alerta meteorológica por la tormenta Bruna, una amenaza de bomba en un vuelo Roma-Lisboa y debates ordinarios sobre vivienda y presupuestos. Las señales positivas incluyen un aumento del 18% en las exportaciones de conservas de pescado y un PSI algo más firme durante la semana, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa cerca de la referencia habitual.
summary.fr: La période paraît ordinaire pour le Portugal : l'essentiel de l'actualité concerne le sport (la retraite internationale de Ronaldo), avec une alerte météo liée à la tempête Bruna, une menace à la bombe sur un vol Rome-Lisbonne et des débats courants sur le logement et le budget. Les signaux positifs comprennent une hausse de 18% des exportations de conserves de poisson et un PSI légèrement plus ferme sur la semaine, si bien que le score se situe près du niveau de référence habituel.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wirkt für Portugal routinemäßig: Der Großteil der Berichterstattung betrifft den Sport (Ronaldos Rücktritt aus der Nationalmannschaft), dazu kommen eine Wetterwarnung wegen Sturm Bruna, eine Bombendrohung bei einem Flug Rom-Lissabon sowie übliche Debatten über Wohnen und Haushalt. Positive Signale sind ein Anstieg der Konservenfisch-Exporte um 18% und ein im Wochenverlauf leicht festerer PSI, weshalb der Wert nahe am üblichen Ausgangsniveau liegt.
summary.pt: O período parece rotineiro para Portugal: a maior parte da cobertura é desportiva (a retirada da seleção de Ronaldo), com um alerta meteorológico da tempestade Bruna, uma ameaça de bomba num voo Roma-Lisboa e debates habituais sobre habitação e orçamento. Os sinais positivos incluem um crescimento de 18% nas exportações de conservas de peixe e um PSI ligeiramente mais firme ao longo da semana, pelo que a pontuação fica perto da linha de base habitual.
summary.ja: ポルトガルにとって、この期間は平常どおりと見られる。報道の大半はスポーツ（ロナウドの代表引退）で、ほかに嵐ブルナによる気象警報、ローマ発リスボン行き便への爆破予告、住宅や予算をめぐる通常の議論が続いた。前向きな材料として、缶詰魚の輸出が18%増え、週間でPSIがやや上昇したため、スコアは通常の基準値付近にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 포르투갈의 이번 기간은 평소와 다름없어 보인다. 보도의 대부분은 스포츠(호날두의 국가대표 은퇴)이며, 폭풍 브루나에 따른 기상 경보, 로마발 리스본행 항공편에 대한 폭탄 위협, 그리고 주택과 예산을 둘러싼 일상적인 논쟁이 있었다. 긍정적 신호로는 통조림 생선 수출이 18% 증가했고 주간 PSI가 소폭 상승하여, 점수는 일반적인 기준선 근처에 머물러 있다.
summary.hi: पुर्तगाल के लिए यह अवधि सामान्य लगती है। अधिकांश कवरेज खेल से जुड़ी है (रोनाल्डो का अंतरराष्ट्रीय संन्यास), साथ ही तूफ़ान ब्रूना की मौसम चेतावनी, रोम-लिस्बन उड़ान पर बम की धमकी और आवास तथा बजट पर सामान्य बहसें हैं। सकारात्मक संकेतों में डिब्बाबंद मछली के निर्यात में 18% की वृद्धि और सप्ताह भर में PSI में हल्की मज़बूती शामिल है, इसलिए स्कोर सामान्य आधार रेखा के आसपास बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος φαίνεται συνηθισμένη για την Πορτογαλία: το μεγαλύτερο μέρος της κάλυψης αφορά τον αθλητισμό (η αποχώρηση του Ρονάλντο από την εθνική ομάδα), με προειδοποίηση καιρού λόγω της καταιγίδας Bruna, απειλή βόμβας σε πτήση Ρώμης-Λισαβόνας και συνηθισμένες συζητήσεις για τη στέγαση και τον προϋπολογισμό. Θετικά σημάδια αποτελούν η αύξηση 18% των εξαγωγών κονσερβοποιημένων ψαριών και η ελαφρώς ισχυρότερη πορεία του PSI μέσα στην εβδομάδα, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται κοντά στη συνηθισμένη βάση.

summary.en: Ebola cases in Kenya rose to eight, and the US raised its travel advisory. At least 17 people died in a road accident, and violent incidents occurred at political events. The conviction of the Shakahola cult leader for 191 murders is an important step for justice, but the case itself is a major humanitarian tragedy. Mashujaa Day celebrations, housing projects and economic agreements provide some balance, but the overall picture is slightly below average.

en: Ebola outbreak: eight cases, US travel advisory raised
Conviction in the Shakahola cult murders (justice served, but a severe humanitarian tragedy)
Political violence: attack on an event attended by Wetangula and Kibet, opposition warnings of violence
At least 17 dead in a road accident
Positive developments such as Mashujaa Day celebrations and the handover of a housing project

summary.en: A mixed day: Mashujaa Day celebrations, the completed Nedbank-NCBA takeover, oil export and refinery progress, and a planned PAYE tax break are constructive. These are offset by a nine-case Ebola cluster, a US travel advisory raised to Level 3, and fuel supply worries.

en: Ebola cases rise to nine; patients reported improving
US raises Kenya travel advisory to Level 3
Nedbank completes NCBA takeover; Turkana oil exports targeted

summary.en: Kenya's news mix is mostly routine, with notable positive investment and conservation financing (Dangote's pipeline stake, a $160m wildlife initiative, an upbeat CEO growth survey). These are offset by an Ebola warning, a US travel advisory and a county workers' strike threat, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Dangote acquires 25% stake in Kenya Pipeline for $327M
WHO warns Ebola outpacing response; US travel advisory issued
47 counties face workers' strike threat over unpaid salaries

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: infrastructure projects, investment news and political jockeying, plus Ebola contacts being traced. Negatives included police assault on a journalist during fuel protests, illicit alcohol deaths and refugees fleeing Ethiopian clashes, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Police assault on a Citizen TV journalist during fuel protests
Ebola contacts all traced; response ramping up
Refugee influx from Ethiopian border clashes

summary.en: A multi-storey building collapse in Eastleigh, Nairobi, with many feared trapped, dominates the period, alongside a second Ebola death, a fatal quarry landslide and an attack on herders. Positive items such as a $160 million wildlife fund and soil-mapping work do not offset these serious problems.

en: Multi-storey building collapse in Eastleigh with many feared trapped
Second Ebola death announced, linked to first patient
Fatal Meru quarry landslide and deadly attack on herders

summary.en: The period mixes a deadly Nairobi building collapse with missing people and a second Ebola death against routine development news such as the SGR budget increase, a court ruling in Tata Chemicals' favour and a suspect's capture. Negative tone is well above the world average, so the score sits below neutral.

en: Nairobi building collapse with several missing and questions over occupied ground-floor shops
Second Ebola death reported, raising health-security concerns
KMPDU strike threat over doctors' salary adjustments in 27 counties

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious accidents: a road crash on the Nairobi-Mombasa highway that killed 22-23 people, a Nairobi building collapse with people missing, and heavy GDELT negativity. Political rivalry and concerns over an elections bill are ongoing, but there are no signs of violent unrest or institutional breakdown.

en: Nairobi-Mombasa highway crashes killed over 40 people in total
Eastleigh building collapse with survivors and people still missing
Opposition warnings that an elections bill could undermine transparency

summary.en: The day mixed serious setbacks, including a fatal bus crash that killed about 22 to 24 people, a Nairobi/Eastleigh building collapse with ongoing rescue work, and an alleged abduction of a Tanzanian activist, with routine political maneuvering ahead of 2027. Positive signals included Ebola contacts being released from quarantine and new infrastructure and investment announcements, and the GDELT tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Fatal bus crash killing 22 to 24 people
Eastleigh and Nairobi building collapse rescue operations
Reported abduction of Tanzanian activist in Machakos

summary.en: The period mixes serious stresses: a Nairobi building collapse with 20 still missing, 284 election-related violence incidents with police linked to 58 deaths, and 36,000 to 40,000 Ethiopians fleeing into Kenya. Positive items, including a Supreme Court rights ruling, investment announcements and Ebola contacts released from quarantine, are routine by comparison.

en: Nairobi building collapse with 20 missing, rescue on day five
284 election-related violence incidents; police linked to 58 deaths
Refugee influx of 36,000-40,000 from Ethiopia to Moyale

summary.en: A mixed, fairly ordinary day: positive signals on Ebola containment, investment and infrastructure sit alongside a building collapse with 16 still missing, rising political-violence concerns before 2027, and an influx of refugees from Ethiopia. GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average, so the score stays near neutral.

en: Africa CDC commends Kenya's Ebola containment measures
Eastleigh building tragedy: 16 still missing after six days
Rights groups sue over political violence ahead of 2027

summary.en: A mixed day: positive institutional and economic items (a court-ordered suspension of the tea levy, a geothermal upgrade, a new rail service, a maternal health investment) sit alongside a large refugee influx from Ethiopia, alleged activist abductions and pre-2027 election tensions. GDELT tone (-0.29) is milder than the world average, so the overall picture is close to an ordinary period.

en: Court-ordered suspension of the contentious tea levy
Nearly 50,000 Ethiopians fleeing into northern Kenya, UN appeal
Alleged cross-border abduction of Tanzanian activist condemned by KNCHR

summary.en: The period mixes serious problems: a Nairobi building collapse with 16 still missing, roughly 50,000 Ethiopians fleeing conflict in Moyale, rising inflation at 7.3%, and gang killings ahead of the 2027 vote. Partial offsets include Russia's pledge to stop recruiting Kenyans and new trade and telecom deals, while the pre-election politics looks largely routine.

en: Ethiopian conflict in Moyale pushes nearly 50,000 refugees into Kenya
Inflation rises to 7.3% as fuel costs bite households
Nairobi building collapse with 16 people still missing

summary.en: The period mixes routine pre-2027 election politics and flood warnings with a deadly Turkana raid and a dispute with Saudi Arabia over Ebola travel curbs. Economic and investment news is modestly positive, including a tribunal clearing the Lamu refinery and a freight service launch, so the day looks close to ordinary.

en: Tribunal clears legal hurdle for Dangote's Lamu refinery
Gunmen kill two in Turkana village raid
Flood deaths and waterlogging across Nairobi and Rift Valley

summary.en: The period is mostly routine pre-2027 election politics and exam administration, with some clear strains: two Ebola deaths in Nairobi, an ongoing building-collapse rescue in Eastleigh, a reported 36,000 refugees entering from Ethiopia, and 92 press freedom violations. A $1 billion port concession plan and water-loss measures add modest positives, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Two Ebola deaths reported in Nairobi with contacts under monitoring
36,000 refugees crossing from Ethiopia after flag dispute
92 press freedom violations and attacks on journalists

summary.en: The period is mostly routine Kenyan politics and business news, with positive economic items (a $77m KenGen storage funding deal, the end of a university strike, bank expansion, 5% growth) offset by security and rights concerns (border clashes near Moyale, an activist's disappearance, an MCA's arrest, Ebola travel restrictions). Net effect is close to an ordinary day, slightly positive.

en: KenGen 100 MW battery storage deal with $77m World Bank and UN funding
End of nationwide university strike and return to lectures
Border clashes with Ethiopia forcing relocation of KCSE centres in Moyale

summary.en: A mixed day with routine politics and several positive items: Ebola patients discharged, a Kenyan judge elected to the ICJ, and a China solar deal. Offsetting these were deadly Turkana border clashes, a lawyer's abduction and flood warnings, so the net is slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Ebola patients discharged and contacts released, signalling outbreak containment
Kenyan Phoebe Okowa elected ICJ judge
Deadly Ethiopian border clashes in Turkana and Moyale refugee influx

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic signals, including a World Bank growth forecast upgrade to 4.6% and a US$78.5M battery storage funding deal, with serious problems such as a Nairobi building collapse that killed five, a 21-day doctors' strike notice, and deadly cross-border clashes in Moyale. The negative news tone is strong, but the mix of routine and serious items keeps the score near an ordinary day.

en: World Bank raises Kenya's 2026 growth forecast to 4.6%
Nairobi building collapse death toll rises to five
KMPDU 21-day strike notice over doctors' salary arrears

summary.en: The period mixes routine pre-election politics and business news with several negative events: an attack on an opposition convoy in Migori, a lawyers' protest over an alleged abduction, and a building collapse that killed at least five. Positive investment and corporate items partly offset these, and GDELT tone is close to the world average.

en: Opposition convoy attacked with stones in Migori during rally
Lawyers march over colleague's alleged abduction
Eastleigh building collapse death toll rises to five

summary.en: The period mixes serious problems, including a claimed 61 deaths in Homa Bay violence, a lawyer's abduction sparking protests, and Ethiopia-linked clashes near Moyale, with positives such as the Shakahola cult leader's 200-year sentence and a strong Quick Mart IPO. Negative news tone is well below the world average, so the score sits in the serious-problems band but short of crisis.
summary.ja: この期間には、ホマ・ベイでの暴力で61人が死亡したと主張されていること、弁護士の拉致が抗議を引き起こしたこと、モヤレ近郊でエチオピアに関連する衝突が起きたことなど、深刻な問題が含まれている。一方で、シャカホラのカルト指導者への200年の刑判決や、クイック・マートの好調な新規株式公開といった明るい話題もある。否定的なニュースの論調は世界平均を大きく下回っており、そのためスコアは「深刻な問題」の範囲にあるが、危機とまではいえない水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 호마베이 폭력 사태로 61명이 사망했다는 주장, 변호사 납치로 촉발된 항의 시위, 모얄레 인근에서 에티오피아와 관련된 충돌 등 심각한 문제들이 포함되어 있습니다. 반면 샤카홀라 사이비 종교 지도자에 대한 200년형 선고와 퀵 마트의 견조한 기업공개(IPO) 같은 긍정적인 소식도 있습니다. 부정적 뉴스의 논조는 세계 평균을 크게 밑돌아, 점수는 '심각한 문제' 구간에 속하지만 위기 수준에는 이르지 않은 것으로 나타났습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में गंभीर समस्याएँ शामिल हैं, जिनमें होमा खाड़ी हिंसा में 61 मौतों का दावा, एक वकील के अपहरण से भड़के विरोध प्रदर्शन, और मोयाले के पास इथियोपिया से जुड़ी झड़पें शामिल हैं। वहीं शकाहोला पंथ के नेता को 200 साल की सजा और क्विक मार्ट के मजबूत आईपीओ जैसी सकारात्मक खबरें भी हैं। नकारात्मक समाचारों का स्वर वैश्विक औसत से काफी कम है, इसलिए स्कोर 'गंभीर समस्याओं' के दायरे में है, लेकिन संकट के स्तर तक नहीं पहुँचता।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει σοβαρά προβλήματα, όπως τους 61 νεκρούς που αναφέρονται στις βίαιες συγκρούσεις του Homa Bay, την απαγωγή ενός δικηγόρου που προκάλεσε διαμαρτυρίες, και τις συγκρούσεις κοντά στο Moyale που σχετίζονται με την Αιθιοπία, με θετικές εξελίξεις όπως η ποινή 200 ετών για τον αρχηγό της αίρεσης Shakahola και η επιτυχημένη εισαγωγή της Quick Mart στο χρηματιστήριο. Ο αρνητικός τόνος των ειδήσεων είναι αισθητά χαμηλότερος από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται στη ζώνη των σοβαρών προβλημάτων, χωρίς ωστόσο να φτάνει σε κρίση.
summary.it: Il periodo combina problemi seri, tra cui un presunto bilancio di 61 morti nelle violenze di Homa Bay, il rapimento di un avvocato che ha scatenato proteste e scontri legati all'Etiopia vicino a Moyale, con aspetti positivi come la condanna a 200 anni del leader della setta di Shakahola e una solida IPO di Quick Mart. Il tono delle notizie negative è ben al di sotto della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio si colloca nella fascia dei problemi seri, ma non di crisi.
summary.ru: Период сочетает серьёзные проблемы, включая заявленные 61 погибший в ходе насилия в Хома-Бэй, похищение адвоката, вызвавшее протесты, и столкновения у Мояле, связанные с Эфиопией, с позитивными событиями, такими как 200-летний приговор лидеру секты Шакахола и успешное IPO Quick Mart. Негативный новостной тон заметно ниже среднемирового, поэтому оценка находится в диапазоне серьёзных проблем, но не кризиса.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين مشكلات خطيرة، منها مقتل 61 شخصًا بحسب ما ورد في أعمال العنف في هوما باي، واختطاف محامٍ أثار احتجاجات، واشتباكات مرتبطة بإثيوبيا قرب موياليه، إلى جانب تطورات إيجابية مثل الحكم بالسجن 200 عام على زعيم طائفة شاكاهولا وطرح أسهم قوي لشركة Quick Mart. ونبرة الأخبار السلبية أقل بكثير من المتوسط العالمي، لذلك تقع الدرجة ضمن نطاق المشكلات الخطيرة دون أن تصل إلى مستوى الأزمة.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از مشکلات جدی است، از جمله ادعای کشته شدن ۶۱ نفر در خشونت‌های هوما بی، ربوده شدن یک وکیل که اعتراضاتی را برانگیخت، و درگیری‌های مرتبط با اتیوپی در نزدیکی مویاله، و در کنار آن نکات مثبتی مانند حکم ۲۰۰ ساله برای رهبر فرقه شاکاهولا و عرضه اولیه سهام قوی کوئیک مارت. لحن اخبار منفی به‌طور قابل توجهی پایین‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین امتیاز در محدوده مشکلات جدی قرار می‌گیرد اما به سطح بحران نمی‌رسد.
summary.zh: 该时段兼有严重问题与积极进展：一是霍马湾暴力事件中据称有61人死亡，一名律师被绑架引发抗议，莫亚莱附近与埃塞俄比亚相关的冲突；积极方面包括沙卡霍拉邪教领袖被判处200年监禁，以及Quick Mart强劲的首次公开募股。负面新闻的语气远低于全球平均水平，因此评分处于严重问题区间，但尚未达到危机程度。
summary.tr: Dönemde ciddi sorunlar bir arada yer alıyor: Homa Bay'deki şiddet olaylarında iddia edilen 61 ölüm, bir avukatın kaçırılmasının başlattığı protestolar ve Moyale yakınlarında Etiyopya bağlantılı çatışmalar. Olumlu gelişmeler arasında Shakahola tarikat liderine verilen 200 yıllık hapis cezası ve güçlü bir Quick Mart halka arz süreci yer alıyor. Olumsuz haber tonu dünya ortalamasının çok altında olduğundan puan ciddi sorunlar bandında, ancak kriz seviyesinin altında kalıyor.
summary.es: El periodo combina problemas graves, como las 61 muertes denunciadas por la violencia en Homa Bay, el secuestro de un abogado que provocó protestas y los enfrentamientos vinculados a Etiopía cerca de Moyale, con aspectos positivos como la condena de 200 años impuesta al líder de la secta de Shakahola y una sólida OPV de Quick Mart. El tono de las noticias negativas está muy por debajo del promedio mundial, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa en la franja de problemas serios, pero sin llegar a crisis.
summary.fr: La période mêle des problèmes graves, notamment les 61 morts revendiqués dans les violences de Homa Bay, l'enlèvement d'un avocat à l'origine de manifestations et des affrontements liés à l'Éthiopie près de Moyale, et des éléments positifs tels que la condamnation à 200 ans de prison du chef de la secte de Shakahola et une introduction en bourse réussie de Quick Mart. Le ton négatif des informations est nettement inférieur à la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que le score se situe dans la tranche des problèmes sérieux sans atteindre celle de la crise.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum vereint gravierende Probleme, darunter die behaupteten 61 Todesopfer bei den Gewalttaten in Homa Bay, die Entführung eines Anwalts, die Proteste auslöste, sowie die mit Äthiopien in Verbindung stehenden Zusammenstöße nahe Moyale, mit positiven Entwicklungen wie der 200-jährigen Haftstrafe für den Anführer der Shakahola-Sekte und einem starken Börsengang von Quick Mart. Der Ton der negativen Nachrichten liegt deutlich unter dem Weltdurchschnitt, sodass der Wert im Bereich ernster Probleme, aber unterhalb einer Krise liegt.
summary.pt: O período combina problemas sérios, incluindo as 61 mortes alegadas na violência em Homa Bay, o sequestro de um advogado que provocou protestos e confrontos ligados à Etiópia perto de Moyale, com aspectos positivos como a sentença de 200 anos para o líder da seita de Shakahola e uma forte oferta pública inicial da Quick Mart. O tom das notícias negativas está bem abaixo da média mundial, por isso a pontuação situa-se na faixa de problemas sérios, mas sem chegar a crise.

en: Claimed 61 killed in Homa Bay violence, with calls for inquiry
Lawyer's abduction prompts LSK and Jogoo House protests
Ethiopia clashes near Moyale drive refugee aid appeals and UK warning
ja: ホマ・ベイでの暴力により61人が死亡したと主張され、調査を求める声が上がっている
弁護士の拉致を受け、LSKとジョゴ・ハウスが抗議を行っている
モヤレ近郊でのエチオピア関連の衝突が難民支援の要請と英国の警告を招いている
ko: 호마베이 폭력 사태로 61명이 사망했다고 주장되며 조사 요구가 이어지고 있음
변호사 납치로 LSK와 조고 하우스가 항의에 나섬
모얄레 인근 에티오피아 관련 충돌로 난민 지원 호소와 영국의 경고가 나옴
hi: होमा खाड़ी हिंसा में 61 लोगों के मारे जाने का दावा, जांच की मांग
वकील के अपहरण से LSK और जोगू हाउस के विरोध प्रदर्शन
मोयाले के पास इथियोपिया से जुड़ी झड़पों से शरणार्थी सहायता की अपीलें और ब्रिटेन की चेतावनी
el: Αναφέρονται 61 νεκροί από τη βία στο Homa Bay, με κλήσεις για διερεύνηση
Η απαγωγή δικηγόρου προκαλεί διαμαρτυρίες της LSK και του Jogoo House
Οι συγκρούσεις με την Αιθιοπία κοντά στο Moyale οδηγούν σε εκκλήσεις για βοήθεια προσφύγων και προειδοποίηση από το Ηνωμένο Βασίλειο
it: Presunti 61 morti nelle violenze di Homa Bay, con richieste di un'indagine
Il rapimento di un avvocato provoca le proteste della LSK e di Jogoo House
Gli scontri vicino a Moyale legati all'Etiopia generano appelli per aiuti ai rifugiati e un avvertimento del Regno Unito
ru: Заявлено о 61 погибшем в ходе насилия в Хома-Бэй, звучат призывы к расследованию
Похищение адвоката вызвало протесты LSK и Jogoo House
Столкновения у Мояле, связанные с Эфиопией, породили призывы о помощи беженцам и предупреждение Великобритании
ar: ورد مقتل 61 شخصًا في أعمال العنف في هوما باي، مع دعوات لفتح تحقيق
اختطاف محامٍ يدفع الجمعية القانونية الكينية وجوجو هاوس إلى الاحتجاج
اشتباكات قرب موياليه مرتبطة بإثيوبيا تثير نداءات لتقديم المساعدات للاجئين وتحذيرًا من المملكة المتحدة
fa: ادعای کشته شدن ۶۱ نفر در خشونت‌های هوما بی و درخواست برای تحقیق
ربوده شدن یک وکیل باعث اعتراض انجمن وکلای کنیا و جوگو هاوس شد
درگیری‌های نزدیک مویاله مرتبط با اتیوپی، درخواست کمک به پناهندگان و هشدار بریتانیا را در پی داشت
zh: 据称霍马湾暴力事件造成61人死亡，有人呼吁展开调查
律师被绑架引发肯尼亚律师协会和Jogoo House抗议
莫亚莱附近与埃塞俄比亚相关的冲突引发难民援助呼吁及英国发出警告
tr: Homa Bay şiddet olaylarında 61 kişinin öldüğü iddia ediliyor; soruşturma çağrıları yapılıyor
Bir avukatın kaçırılması LSK ve Jogoo House protestolarına yol açtı
Moyale yakınlarındaki Etiyopya bağlantılı çatışmalar mülteci yardımı çağrılarını ve İngiltere uyarısını beraberinde getirdi
es: Se denuncian 61 muertos por la violencia en Homa Bay y se piden investigaciones
El secuestro de un abogado provoca protestas de la LSK y de Jogoo House
Los enfrentamientos cerca de Moyale vinculados a Etiopía generan llamamientos de ayuda a refugiados y una advertencia del Reino Unido
fr: 61 morts revendiqués dans les violences de Homa Bay, appels à une enquête
L'enlèvement d'un avocat suscite des manifestations de la LSK et de Jogoo House
Les affrontements près de Moyale liés à l'Éthiopie entraînent des appels à l'aide aux réfugiés et une mise en garde du Royaume-Uni
de: Behauptete 61 Tote bei Gewalt in Homa Bay, Forderungen nach einer Untersuchung
Entführung eines Anwalts löst Proteste von LSK und Jogoo House aus
Zusammenstöße nahe Moyale mit Bezug zu Äthiopien führen zu Hilfsaufrufen für Flüchtlinge und einer Warnung des Vereinigten Königreichs
pt: 61 mortes alegadas na violência em Homa Bay, com pedidos de inquérito
O sequestro de um advogado provoca protestos da LSK e da Jogoo House
Confrontos perto de Moyale ligados à Etiópia geram apelos de ajuda a refugiados e um alerta do Reino Unido

summary.en: Student-led protests in Albania, now in their seventh day, have escalated into clashes in Tirana involving Molotov cocktails, fires and police. Many detentions and allegations of police brutality have been reported, and the Supreme Court building is reported to have been set on fire. Prime Minister Rama rejects resignation and calls for dialogue with civil society, but the crisis is deepening. The Central Bank's statement that deposits are safe points to financial concern; however, because no mass casualties or state collapse have been reported, the score is not in the lowest range.

en: Violent clashes with Molotov cocktails and fires in Tirana, seventh day of protests
Police violence and numerous detentions; criticism from AP and civil society
Attack on the Supreme Court building and pressure on institutions
Rama's resistance to resignation demands, political polarization
Central Bank statement on deposit security, economic unease

summary.en: Albania's eighth day of student-led anti-government protests in Tirana produced nightly clashes with police, Molotov cocktails, stone-throwing, dozens of arrests, and an alleged attack on the Supreme Court. Opposition and foreign media describe a serious political crisis, though the situation is not a war or coup.

en: Eighth consecutive day of protests with nightly police clashes in Tirana
Dozens arrested; violence reported at the cathedral and Supreme Court
Calls for PM Rama to resign amid heavy pressure on institutions

summary.en: Albania is in its tenth day of student-led protests over corruption and a Kushner-linked resort deal, with reports of violence, arrests, police attacks on journalists and international concern. The only clearly positive item is a record rise in foreign reserves, which does not offset the unrest.

en: Ongoing violent student protests, now on their tenth day
Police attacks on journalists and arrests at protests
International organisations expressing concern; government offering dialogue amid tension

summary.en: Albania is in its tenth day of student-led protests that have turned partly violent, with police and protesters injured, a physical brawl in parliament, and calls for the prime minister's resignation. The government calls the unrest a hybrid threat, and the sharply negative news tone points to serious political strain on institutions.

en: Ongoing student protests escalating into violence over ten days
Parliament brawl and blockade attempts by protesters
Calls for Prime Minister Rama's resignation and a technical government

summary.en: Albania is in a deepening political crisis: student and doctor protests against Prime Minister Rama are spreading, parliament saw a physical brawl, and the government is threatening arrests and accusing protesters of foreign backing. Partial positives, such as the EU-related ARLEM welcome and resignations of 132 officials, do not offset the escalating unrest.

en: Student and doctor protests spreading, demanding Rama's resignation
Fistfight in parliament over the student protests
Government threats of arrests and claims of Iranian or Antifa involvement

summary.en: Albania saw its 12th consecutive anti-government protest in Tirana end in clashes, with molotov cocktails, tear gas, and about eight injured, as opposition and student mobilisation grew and calls for the prime minister's resignation intensified. Foreign and domestic media both report sustained unrest and a tense political standoff, though no collapse of institutions is reported.

en: Protest #12 in Tirana ended in violent clashes with police
Molotov cocktails, tear gas and about eight injured reported
Opposition and student protests grow; calls for PM's resignation

summary.en: Albania saw a continuing wave of student-led protests in Tirana, with clashes, arson at a ministry entrance and 9 injured, and a government anti-violence package with heavy fines. Opposition and critics call the package repressive, and tourism bookings are reportedly being cancelled, which places the period in serious-problems territory short of a crisis of state.

en: Street clashes and arson at ministry entrance in Tirana
Government anti-violence package with fines up to 5,500 euros
Accusations of police violence and authoritarian drift

summary.en: Albania's period was dominated by protest-related tension, with foreign and opposition media reporting police violence, injuries to protesters and claims of a crackdown. A food VAT cut from 20% to 6% and a strong tourism season partly offset this, but the overall picture is serious strain on public trust and institutions.

en: Protest crackdown reports: batons, tear gas, plastic bullets, protester injuries
German doctors ask Bundestag to probe police violence
Food VAT cut from 20% to 6% in fiscal package

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a World Bank forecast of 3.4% growth with public debt falling below 50% of GDP, road contracts, and arrests in criminal cases. Ongoing student and youth anti-corruption protests and an opposition call for a national protest add political tension, but no crackdown appears in the headlines.

en: World Bank forecasts 3.4% growth and public debt below 50% of GDP
Student and youth anti-corruption protests continue, with an opposition protest called for 31 October
Routine infrastructure contracts and criminal arrests, with no crisis reported

summary.en: The period is dominated by protests met with reported rubber-bullet use against protesters and journalists, a deepening corruption scandal involving former Tirana mayor Veliaj and the Balluku case, and US congressional pressure over corruption. The government's response of ten new tax measures and a routine 2027 budget presentation provide some balancing counterweight.

en: Reports of rubber bullets used against protesters and journalists, flagged by BIRN
Veliaj jailed and transferred amid corruption scandal; Balluku case unresolved
US Republican congressmen urge visa restrictions over Albanian official corruption

summary.en: Tirana protests over the transfer of mayor Erion Veliaj to Fier prison drew a harsh response: arrests of protesters, reported fines of up to 5,500 euros, and expanded police powers. Positive items (2027 budget, wind park agreement, environmental petitions) do not offset the crackdown and the political tension.

en: Veliaj transfer to Fier prison disputed as unlawful, sparking protests
Police arrests of protesters and fines up to 5,500 euros
Government reportedly expanded police powers amid protests

summary.en: Albania is in a serious political crisis: Tirana mayor Erion Veliaj is in pretrial detention, the PM labels him a coup plotter, and violent student-led protests have drawn EU condemnation. A US letter questioning the government and a contested fiscal package add to the pressure on institutions, though there is no war or state breakdown.

en: Violent protests in Albania drew EU ambassador condemnation
Mayor Veliaj detained; Rama accuses him of coup plotting
US letter to Rubio raising questions about the government

summary.en: Albania is in its 19th day of student protests in Tirana demanding the government's resignation, with reports of molotov cocktails, burning barricades, smoke bombs in parliament, and police using water cannon and tear gas. Other coverage is routine (obituaries, cultural news), and the country's institutions still function, so the score sits in the serious-problems band rather than the crisis band.

en: Ongoing 19-day student protests demanding PM Rama's resignation
Clashes in Tirana: molotov cocktails, burning barricades, police water cannon and tear gas
Smoke bombs disrupting parliament; opposition protests heading to Tirana

summary.en: Albania faces its 21st consecutive day of anti-government protests in Tirana, with Molotov cocktails thrown, police using water cannons and tear gas, and protesters attacking the Council of Ministers while the prime minister refuses to resign. Separate concerns about the detention of former mayor Veliaj and a bomb attack on a politician add to the strain on institutions.

en: Three weeks of protests with clashes, Molotov cocktails and police tear gas
Protesters attack Council of Ministers; PM refuses to resign
Helsinki Committee concerns over secret order and detention of Veliaj

summary.en: Albania is in its 21st day of student-led anti-government protests in Tirana, with reports of Molotov cocktails, water cannon and tear gas, and calls for the government's resignation. The jailing of Mayor Veliaj and rights-group concerns add pressure on institutions, while the 2027 budget news is routine.

en: Three weeks of Tirana protests met with water cannon and tear gas
Mayor Veliaj jailed; Helsinki Committee raises concerns over treatment
Protesters demand government resignation; violence reported at rallies

summary.en: Albania's period is marked by a political clash between Prime Minister Rama and Tirana mayor Veliaj, a court case postponement, and ongoing student protests with calls for a caretaker government. Positive signals include an EU-Eurojust call-centre fraud takedown with SPAK participation, increased student scholarships, and a NATO summit in Tirana, but the negative news tone is clearly stronger than the world average.

en: Rama-Veliaj clash and calls for an independent SPAK investigation
Ongoing student protests and opposition calls for a caretaker government
Eurojust-backed call-centre fraud network dismantled with SPAK participation

summary.en: Albania's period mixes a positive EU progress report, with four chapters closed and praise from Kallas, against an ongoing political crisis: student protests demanding the PM's resignation, the arrest of Tirana's mayor Veliaj, and a record trade deficit. No harsh crackdown appears in the headlines, so the overall picture stays close to an ordinary day.

en: EU progress report praises justice and economy, four chapters closed
Ongoing student protests and political clashes around Rama and Veliaj
Record 5.8 billion euro trade deficit flagged by business federation

summary.en: Albania's 24 hours mixed a positive EU progress report, with the EU calling the country on the 'last kilometre' of accession talks and praising the central bank law, against an ongoing 22-day student protest movement. Authorities fined 83 protesters under new rally laws, there were reports of violence in Tirana, and the opposition alleged authoritarianism, which keeps the score below routine.

en: EU progress report says accession talks reached the 'last kilometre'
Authorities fined 83 protesters under new anti-rally laws
Ongoing multi-week student protests with reports of violence in Tirana

summary.en: Ten months of student protests in Tirana continue, with reported violence, detentions of 83 demonstrators and foreign concern about press freedom, which weigh heavily on the score. Positive economic and institutional news (1.14bn euro FDI, Wizz Air expansion, EU praise for the central bank law, road funding) partly offsets this.
summary.ja: ティラナでは10か月にわたる学生抗議が続いており、暴力行為の報告、デモ参加者83人の拘束、そして報道の自由に対する海外からの懸念があり、これらがスコアを大きく押し下げている。経済や制度面での前向きなニュース(11億4,000万ユーロの対内直接投資、Wizz Airの路線拡大、中央銀行法に対するEUの評価、道路整備予算)が、その影響を一部相殺している。
summary.ko: 티라나에서는 10개월째 이어지는 학생 시위가 계속되고 있으며, 폭력 사태 보도, 시위대 83명 구금, 언론의 자유에 대한 해외의 우려가 점수를 크게 끌어내리고 있다. 경제 및 제도 분야의 긍정적 소식(11억 4천만 유로의 외국인 직접투자, Wizz Air의 노선 확대, 중앙은행법에 대한 EU의 호평, 도로 예산)이 이를 부분적으로 상쇄하고 있다.
summary.hi: तिराना में दस महीनों से चल रहे छात्र विरोध प्रदर्शन जारी हैं, जिनमें हिंसा की रिपोर्टें, 83 प्रदर्शनकारियों की हिरासत और प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता पर विदेशी चिंता शामिल हैं, जो स्कोर पर भारी पड़ रही हैं। आर्थिक और संस्थागत मोर्चे की सकारात्मक खबरें (1.14 अरब यूरो का FDI, Wizz Air का विस्तार, केंद्रीय बैंक कानून पर यूरोपीय संघ की प्रशंसा, सड़क वित्तपोषण) इसका आंशिक रूप से संतुलन करती हैं।
summary.el: Οι φοιτητικές διαμαρτυρίες στα Τίρανα συνεχίζονται εδώ και δέκα μήνες, με αναφορές για βία, κρατήσεις 83 διαδηλωτών και ανησυχία του εξωτερικού για την ελευθερία του Τύπου, οι οποίες επιβαρύνουν σημαντικά τη βαθμολογία. Θετικές οικονομικές και θεσμικές ειδήσεις (άμεσες ξένες επενδύσεις 1,14 δισ. ευρώ, επέκταση της Wizz Air, επαινετική στάση της ΕΕ για τον νόμο της κεντρικής τράπεζας, χρηματοδότηση οδικών έργων) μετριάζουν εν μέρει αυτή την εικόνα.
summary.it: Dieci mesi di proteste studentesche a Tirana proseguono, con violenze segnalate, 83 manifestanti fermati e preoccupazione internazionale per la libertà di stampa, che pesano molto sul punteggio. Notizie economiche e istituzionali positive (1,14 miliardi di euro di IDE, espansione di Wizz Air, apprezzamento dell'UE per la legge sulla banca centrale, finanziamenti stradali) compensano in parte questo quadro.
summary.ru: Десять месяцев студенческих протестов в Тиране продолжаются; сообщается о насилии, задержании 83 демонстрантов и обеспокоенности иностранных партнеров свободой прессы, что сильно снижает оценку. Позитивные экономические и институциональные новости (прямые иностранные инвестиции на 1,14 млрд евро, расширение Wizz Air, одобрение ЕС закона о центральном банке, финансирование дорог) частично компенсируют это.
summary.ar: تتواصل للشهر العاشر على التوالي احتجاجات الطلاب في تيرانا، مع تقارير عن أعمال عنف واحتجاز 83 متظاهراً وقلق دولي بشأن حرية الصحافة، وهو ما يثقل كاهل التقييم بشكل كبير. وتخفف الأخبار الاقتصادية والمؤسسية الإيجابية (استثمارات أجنبية مباشرة بقيمة 1.14 مليار يورو، وتوسع شركة Wizz Air، وإشادة الاتحاد الأوروبي بقانون البنك المركزي، وتمويل الطرق) جزئياً من هذا الأثر.
summary.fa: ده ماه اعتراض دانشجویی در تیرانا ادامه دارد و گزارش‌هایی از خشونت، بازداشت ۸۳ معترض و نگرانی خارجی درباره آزادی مطبوعات منتشر شده است که امتیاز را به‌شدت پایین می‌آورد. اخبار مثبت اقتصادی و نهادی (سرمایه‌گذاری مستقیم خارجی به ارزش ۱٫۱۴ میلیارد یورو، گسترش فعالیت ویزایر، ستایش اتحادیه اروپا از قانون بانک مرکزی، تأمین مالی جاده‌ها) تا حدی این اثر را جبران می‌کند.
summary.zh: 地拉那的学生抗议已持续十个月，据报道出现暴力事件，83名示威者被拘留，外国对新闻自由表示担忧，这些因素严重拖累了评分。积极的经济和制度性新闻（11.4亿欧元外国直接投资、Wizz Air扩张、欧盟赞扬央行法、道路融资）部分抵消了这一影响。
summary.tr: Tiran'da on aydır süren öğrenci protestoları devam ediyor; bildirilen şiddet olayları, 83 göstericinin gözaltına alınması ve basın özgürlüğüne ilişkin uluslararası kaygılar skoru ciddi biçimde olumsuz etkiliyor. Olumlu ekonomik ve kurumsal gelişmeler (1.14bn euro doğrudan yabancı yatırım, Wizz Air'in genişlemesi, AB'nin merkez bankası yasasını övmesi, yol finansmanı) bunu kısmen dengeliyor.
summary.es: Continúan durante diez meses las protestas estudiantiles en Tirana, con violencia reportada, la detención de 83 manifestantes y la preocupación internacional por la libertad de prensa, factores que pesan considerablemente en la puntuación. Las noticias económicas e institucionales positivas (1.14bn euros de IED, la expansión de Wizz Air, el elogio de la UE a la ley del banco central y la financiación de carreteras) compensan en parte esta situación.
summary.fr: Dix mois de manifestations étudiantes se poursuivent à Tirana, avec des violences signalées, la détention de 83 manifestants et les préoccupations internationales concernant la liberté de la presse, des éléments qui pèsent lourdement sur le score. Des nouvelles économiques et institutionnelles positives (1.14bn euros d'IDE, l'expansion de Wizz Air, les éloges de l'UE pour la loi sur la banque centrale, le financement routier) compensent en partie cette situation.
summary.de: In Tirana dauern die studentischen Proteste seit zehn Monaten an; gemeldete Gewalt, die Festnahme von 83 Demonstranten und internationale Besorgnis über die Pressefreiheit belasten die Bewertung stark. Positive wirtschaftliche und institutionelle Nachrichten (1,14 Mrd. Euro an ausländischen Direktinvestitionen, die Ausweitung von Wizz Air, das Lob der EU für das Zentralbankgesetz, Straßenfinanzierung) gleichen dies teilweise aus.
summary.pt: Os protestos estudantis em Tirana prosseguem há dez meses, com violência relatada, a detenção de 83 manifestantes e preocupação internacional com a liberdade de imprensa, fatores que pesam fortemente na pontuação. Notícias econômicas e institucionais positivas (1,14 bilhão de euros em IDE, a expansão da Wizz Air, o elogio da UE à lei do banco central e o financiamento de estradas) compensam parcialmente esse cenário.

en: Ongoing student protests with violence and 83 detained demonstrators
Dutch ambassador shocked by protest violence; press freedom concerns
EU praise for central bank law and 1.14bn euro FDI inflows
ja: 暴力を伴う学生抗議の継続とデモ参加者83人の拘束
オランダ大使が抗議時の暴力に衝撃を表明;報道の自由への懸念
中央銀行法に対するEUの評価と11億4,000万ユーロの対内直接投資流入
ko: 폭력을 동반한 학생 시위 지속 및 시위대 83명 구금

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: official media report 6.3% GDP growth for January-October, a green schools certification, and energy and border cooperation deals. Independent reports of raids on disabled people and child beggars, and of authorities blocking a worker protest at Özak, offset the positives.

summary.es: El periodo transcurre en gran medida con normalidad: los medios oficiales informan de un crecimiento del PIB del 6,3 % de enero a octubre, una certificación de escuelas ecológicas y acuerdos de cooperación energética y fronteriza. Los informes independientes sobre redadas contra personas con discapacidad y niños mendigos, y sobre el bloqueo por parte de las autoridades de una protesta de trabajadores en Özak, compensan los aspectos positivos.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : les médias officiels font état d'une croissance du PIB de 6,3 % de janvier à octobre, d'une certification écologique des écoles et d'accords de coopération énergétique et frontalière. Des informations indépendantes faisant état de rafles visant des personnes handicapées et des enfants mendiants, ainsi que du blocage par les autorités d'une manifestation de travailleurs à Özak, contrebalancent ces éléments positifs.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Staatliche Medien melden ein BIP-Wachstum von 6,3 % für Januar bis Oktober, eine Umweltzertifizierung für Schulen sowie Abkommen über Energie- und Grenzkooperation. Unabhängige Berichte über Razzien gegen Menschen mit Behinderungen und bettelnde Kinder sowie über die Blockade einer Arbeiterprotestaktion in Özak durch die Behörden stehen den positiven Meldungen jedoch gegenüber.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, de rotina: a mídia oficial relata crescimento do PIB de 6,3% de janeiro a outubro, uma certificação ecológica para escolas e acordos de cooperação em energia e fronteiras. Relatos independentes sobre batidas contra pessoas com deficiência e crianças mendigas, e sobre autoridades bloqueando um protesto de trabalhadores em Özak, contrabalançam os aspectos positivos.
summary.ja: 今期は概ね通常の動きです。政府系メディアは1月から10月までの国内総生産(GDP)の成長率を6.3%と報じ、また環境に配慮した学校の認証、エネルギーおよび国境管理に関する協力協定が伝えられています。一方で、トルクメンバシ市での障害者および物乞いをする子どもへの取り締まりや、オザク(Özak)での労働者の抗議を当局が阻止したとする独立系の報道があり、これらが前向きな動きを相殺しています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 흐름입니다. 관영 매체는 1월부터 10월까지 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률이 6.3%였다고 보도했으며, 친환경 학교 인증과 에너지 및 국경 협력 협정도 전해졌습니다. 반면 투르크멘바시에서 장애인과 구걸하는 아동을 대상으로 한 단속이 있었고, 당국이 오자크(Özak)의 노동자 시위를 막았다는 독립 언론의 보도가 긍정적인 소식을 상쇄하고 있습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि अधिकतर सामान्य रही है। सरकारी मीडिया ने जनवरी से अक्टूबर तक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में 6.3% वृद्धि की सूचना दी है, साथ ही हरित विद्यालय प्रमाणन और ऊर्जा तथा सीमा सहयोग समझौतों की भी खबरें हैं। वहीं स्वतंत्र रिपोर्टों के अनुसार तुर्कमेनबाशी में विकलांग लोगों और भीख माँगते बच्चों पर छापेमारी हुई, और अधिकारियों ने ओज़ाक (Özak) में कामगारों के विरोध प्रदर्शन को रोका, जिससे इन सकारात्मक खबरों का असर कम हो गया है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη. Τα επίσημα μέσα ενημέρωσης αναφέρουν αύξηση του ΑΕΠ κατά 6,3% για την περίοδο Ιανουαρίου-Οκτωβρίου, μια πιστοποίηση πράσινων σχολείων και συμφωνίες συνεργασίας στον τομέα της ενέργειας και των συνόρων. Ανεξάρτητες αναφορές για επιδρομές σε άτομα με αναπηρία και παιδιά που ζητιανεύουν στο Τουρκμενμπάσι, καθώς και για το ότι οι αρχές απέκλεισαν δήλωση εργαζομένων στο Özak, αντισταθμίζουν τα θετικά στοιχεία.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: i media ufficiali riportano una crescita del PIL del 6,3% da gennaio a ottobre, una certificazione ecologica per le scuole e accordi di cooperazione in materia di energia e frontiere. Le segnalazioni indipendenti di retate contro persone con disabilità e bambini mendicanti, e di autorità che hanno bloccato una protesta dei lavoratori a Özak, controbilanciano gli aspetti positivi.
summary.ru: Период в целом рутинный: официальные СМИ сообщают о росте ВВП на 6,3% за январь–октябрь, о сертификации школ по экологическим стандартам и о соглашениях в сфере энергетики и пограничного сотрудничества. Независимые сообщения о рейдах против инвалидов и детей-попрошаек, а также о том, что власти заблокировали заявление работников Озака, перевешивают эти позитивные новости.

summary.en: The period is mostly routine governance and development news, with several positive items: a Shs 102bn epidemic grant, a 21% profit rise at a major phone firm, the oil pipeline reaching 92% completion, and reports of regained institutional trust. Negative signals include the army chief's planned step-down, justice-sector trust concerns, and the Ebola outbreak and ADF attacks in neighbouring DR Congo, which weigh against the GDELT tone of -2.30.
summary.it: Il periodo è composto per lo più da notizie di routine su governance e sviluppo, con diversi elementi positivi: una sovvenzione epidemica da Shs 102bn, un aumento del 21% dei profitti di una grande azienda di telefonia, il completamento del 92% dell'oleodotto e segnalazioni di una fiducia istituzionale recuperata. I segnali negativi includono il previsto passo indietro del capo dell'esercito, le preoccupazioni sulla fiducia nel settore della giustizia e l'epidemia di Ebola e gli attacchi ADF nella vicina RD Congo, che pesano sul tono GDELT di -2.30.
summary.ru: Период в основном состоит из рутинных новостей о государственном управлении и развитии, с несколькими позитивными событиями: эпидемиологический грант на сумму Shs 102bn, рост прибыли крупной телефонной компании на 21%, завершение строительства нефтепровода на 92% и сообщения о восстановлении доверия к институтам. Негативные сигналы включают запланированную отставку начальника армии, опасения по поводу доверия к судебной системе, а также вспышку Эболы и нападения ADF в соседней ДР Конго, что снижает показатель тональности GDELT до -2.30.
summary.ar: تتألف الفترة في معظمها من أخبار روتينية عن الحوكمة والتنمية، مع عدة مؤشرات إيجابية: منحة وبائية بقيمة Shs 102bn، وارتفاع أرباح شركة هواتف كبرى بنسبة 21%، وبلوغ إنجاز خط أنابيب النفط نسبة 92%، وتقارير عن استعادة الثقة المؤسسية. أما المؤشرات السلبية فتشمل التنحي المخطط له لقائد الجيش، ومخاوف بشأن الثقة في قطاع العدالة، وتفشي فيروس إيبولا وهجمات ADF في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية المجاورة، وهي عوامل تثقل على نبرة GDELT البالغة -2.30.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل اخبار معمول حکمرانی و توسعه است، با چند مورد مثبت: کمک‌هزینه همه‌گیری به مبلغ Shs 102bn، افزایش 21% سود یک شرکت بزرگ تلفن همراه، تکمیل 92% خط لوله نفت و گزارش‌هایی درباره بازیابی اعتماد نهادی. سیگنال‌های منفی شامل کناره‌گیری برنامه‌ریزی‌شده فرمانده ارتش، نگرانی‌ها درباره اعتماد به بخش قضایی، و شیوع ابولا و حملات ADF در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگوی همسایه است که لحن GDELT را که برابر -2.30 است تحت فشار قرار می‌دهد.
summary.zh: 该时期主要是常规治理和发展新闻，并有几项积极消息：102bn先令的疫情拨款、一家大型手机公司利润增长21%、石油管道完成92%，以及有报道称机构信任有所恢复。负面信号包括陆军司令计划辞职、司法部门信任问题，以及邻国刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情和ADF袭击，这些因素拖累了GDELT情绪值-2.30。
summary.ja: この期間は大半が日常的な行政・開発関連のニュースで、いくつかの前向きな項目がある。伝染病対策のShs 102bn（102億シリング）の助成金、大手携帯電話会社の利益21%増、石油パイプラインの完成度92%への到達、制度への信頼回復の報道などである。否定的な兆候としては、陸軍司令官の退任計画、司法部門の信頼に関する懸念、そして隣国コンゴ民主共和国（DR Congo）でのエボラ出血熱の発生とADFによる攻撃があり、これらはGDELTのトーン値-2.30を押し下げる要因となっている。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 대체로 일상적인 행정 및 개발 관련 뉴스이며, 긍정적인 항목도 몇 가지 있습니다. 전염병 대응을 위한 Shs 102bn 규모의 보조금, 주요 휴대전화 회사의 이익 21% 증가, 송유관 공사 92% 완료, 제도적 신뢰 회복 보도 등입니다. 부정적 신호로는 육군 참모총장의 계획된 사임, 사법 부문 신뢰 우려, 그리고 인접한 콩고민주공화국(DR Congo)의 에볼라 발병과 ADF 공격이 있으며, 이는 GDELT 톤 점수 -2.30을 끌어내리는 요인입니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित शासन और विकास से जुड़ी खबरों की है, जिसमें कई सकारात्मक बातें शामिल हैं: महामारी के लिए Shs 102bn का अनुदान, एक प्रमुख फ़ोन कंपनी के मुनाफ़े में 21% की वृद्धि, तेल पाइपलाइन का 92% पूरा होना, और संस्थागत विश्वास बहाल होने की रिपोर्टें। नकारात्मक संकेतों में सेना प्रमुख का प्रस्तावित पद त्याग, न्याय क्षेत्र में विश्वास संबंधी चिंताएँ, और पड़ोसी DR Congo में इबोला प्रकोप और ADF हमले शामिल हैं, जो GDELT के -2.30 टोन को नीचे खींचते हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος αποτελείται κυρίως από ρουτίνα διακυβέρνησης και ειδήσεις ανάπτυξης, με αρκετές θετικές εξελίξεις: επιχορήγηση Shs 102bn για την αντιμετώπιση επιδημιών, αύξηση κερδών 21% σε μια μεγάλη εταιρεία κινητής τηλεφωνίας, ολοκλήρωση του αγωγού πετρελαίου σε ποσοστό 92% και αναφορές για ανάκτηση της θεσμικής εμπιστοσύνης. Τα αρνητικά σήματα περιλαμβάνουν την προγραμματισμένη παραίτηση του αρχηγού του στρατού, ανησυχίες για την εμπιστοσύνη στον τομέα της δικαιοσύνης, και την επιδημία Ebola και τις επιθέσεις ADF στη γειτονική DR Congo, που βαραίνουν το τόνο GDELT των -2.30.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin yönetişim ve kalkınma haberlerinden oluşuyor; birkaç olumlu gelişme var: Shs 102bn tutarında salgın hibesi, büyük bir telefon şirketinin kârında %21 artış, petrol boru hattının %92 oranında tamamlanmasına ulaşması ve kurumsal güvenin yeniden kazanıldığına dair haberler. Olumsuz sinyaller arasında ordu komutanının planlanan görevden ayrılması, yargı sektörüne duyulan güvene ilişkin kaygılar ile komşu DR Kongo'daki Ebola salgını ve ADF saldırıları yer alıyor; bunlar GDELT tonu olan -2.30 değerini aşağı çekiyor.
summary.es: El periodo consiste en su mayoría en noticias rutinarias de gobernanza y desarrollo, con varios aspectos positivos: una subvención de Shs 102bn para epidemias, un aumento del 21% en los beneficios de una importante empresa de telefonía, la finalización del 92% del oleoducto y informes sobre la recuperación de la confianza institucional. Entre las señales negativas figuran la salida prevista del jefe del ejército, las preocupaciones sobre la confianza en el sector judicial, y el brote de ébola y los ataques de ADF en la vecina República Democrática del Congo, que pesan frente al tono GDELT de -2.30.
summary.fr: La période se compose surtout d'actualités courantes de gouvernance et de développement, avec plusieurs éléments positifs : une subvention de Shs 102bn pour les épidémies, une hausse de 21% des bénéfices d'une grande entreprise de téléphonie, un oléoduc achevé à 92% et des informations faisant état d'un retour de la confiance envers les institutions. Les signaux négatifs comprennent le départ prévu du chef d'état-major de l'armée, les inquiétudes concernant la confiance dans le secteur de la justice, ainsi que l'épidémie d'Ebola et les attaques des ADF dans la République démocratique du Congo voisine, qui pèsent sur le ton GDELT de -2.30.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum besteht überwiegend aus routinemäßigen Nachrichten zu Regierungsführung und Entwicklung, mit mehreren positiven Meldungen: eine Zuwendung von Shs 102bn für Epidemien, ein Gewinnanstieg von 21% bei einem großen Telefonunternehmen, eine Fertigstellung der Ölpipeline zu 92% und Berichte über wiedergewonnenes Vertrauen in Institutionen. Negative Signale sind der geplante Rücktritt des Armeechefs, Bedenken hinsichtlich des Vertrauens in den Justizsektor sowie der Ebola-Ausbruch und ADF-Angriffe in der benachbarten Demokratischen Republik Kongo, die den GDELT-Tonwert von -2.30 belasten.
summary.pt: O período é composto em sua maioria por notícias rotineiras de governança e desenvolvimento, com vários itens positivos: uma subvenção de Shs 102bn para epidemias, um aumento de 21% nos lucros de uma grande empresa de telefonia, o oleoduto atingindo 92% de conclusão e relatos de recuperação da confiança institucional. Os sinais negativos incluem a saída planejada do chefe do exército, preocupações com a confiança no setor de justiça, e o surto de Ebola e os ataques das ADF na vizinha República Democrática do Congo, que pesam contra o tom GDELT de -2.30.

summary.en: Paraguay's news over the period is mostly routine, with a flood emergency on the Paraná affecting several thousand families. Positive developments include a security agreement with the US against narco-flights, record soybean export prospects, a child-marriage ban passed by the lower house, and new market access for tomatoes. Tone is less negative than the world average.

summary.en: Paraguay is in a serious financial and political crisis: the central bank seized Ueno Bank, freezing savings of millions of customers, and the central bank chief resigned at the president's request. Opposition calls for the president's exit and reports of disturbances add strain on institutions, though the period shows no violence on a war or coup scale.

en: Central bank intervention of Ueno Bank freezes savings of millions of clients
Central bank chief resigns at president's request amid the crisis
